rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control Regulations ch. 14 – Security deposits (ceiling, interest-bearing account, additional deposit by agreement)
rules.requirement: For controlled rental units, the security deposit generally cannot exceed the maximum allowable rent or base rent after vacancy at the start of the tenancy, and cannot be raised during the tenancy. Qualifying small landlords (natural persons or all-natural-person LLCs owning no more than two properties with four units total) may charge two months' rent unless the tenant is a service member. All deposits must be held in an FDIC/FSLIC-insured interest-bearing account, and for pre-1999 tenancies up to one more month may be collected by written consent, within the state-law maximum.
rules.key_value: 1 month's max allowable rent; 2 months for qualifying small landlords (eff. 8/17/24)
rules.interaction: The 8/8/24 amendment (effective 8/17/24) added the two-month small-landlord option to § 14002(b) and capped combined deposits under § 14003 at the state-law maximum, so the local ceiling operates alongside Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5.
rules.citation: Santa Monica Rent Control Board Reg. § 14002
rules.quoted_span:
the maximum allowable security deposit for any tenant
who rents a controlled rental unit subsequent to January 1, 1983 is no more than an amount equal to the
maximum allowable rent or base rent after vacancy in effect on the initial rental date

requires_unknown_facts: unit is a controlled rental unit under Santa Monica rent control
unverifiable_exemptions: small landlord (natural person/LLC of natural persons, <=2 properties, <=4 units) two-month option
§ 14003 additional deposit applies only to tenancies commencing before 1/1/1999
coverage.landlord_size_condition: owner is a natural person or all-natural-person LLC owning no more than two rental properties with no more than four units total (for two-month deposit)

rules.effective_date_note: Section 14002 amended 11/17/83, effective 12/7/83 (chapter originally adopted 7/21/83, effective 8/1/83); two-month small-landlord option added by amendment effective 8/17/24.
rules.prior_version_note: Ceiling of one month's max allowable rent (or base rent) applied since 1983, with amendments in 1999; the 8/17/24 amendment added a two-month option for qualifying small landlords.
